title: trailboss --json task budget
description: Setting or clearing a task's budget (the dollars its agent and reviewers may spend between them), one row: would set / set, or would clear / cleared. Without --yes nothing changes. Over its budget, a task's automatic reviewer and the tasks queued --after it wait; raising the budget above what it spent, or clearing it, lets them start at the next look. Frontends should show an action they don't know as is.

action.description: would set, set, would clear or cleared; more may be added.

detail.description: The budget it has after, and the one it had before.
